trigger: Power the maglocks with the cart (annex_maglock_power). The torpor holds. The flooded lower wing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You cable the cart into the building's dead bus. The cart roars. One by one, the maglocks thunk open in the dark.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wing A. A corridor of glass holds, each the size of a phone booth. Every one is open. Latches torn from the inside.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Holds A1 through A6. My wing. I knew each of them. I named them. Nobody was supposed to name them.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: On the records room desk: the manifest. Half the pages are redacted. The rest are swollen with water.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: SUBJECTS (WING A): 6. SUBJECTS (WING B): ███████. B-WING ACCESS: LEVEL 5 ONLY.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: I was level three. I never saw B. Nobody had all the numbers. That was the point of how they built it.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: I don't know. I honestly don't know. Six from my wing. B wing... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: There was a page I never had clearance for. 'Integration.' I don't know what they do out there, starving.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Stairs down. Black water at the bottom. The stairwell door to B wing is bent outward. Forced.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Won't go down the stairs. Sits at the top. Whines once. Then silence.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Below, the lower wing is flooded to the ceiling. Collapsed. Whatever was in there either drowned or got out.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: [Very quietly] The diesel ran out on day sixteen. The holds warmed. I heard them waking up. I opened the outer door.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: I told myself it was to get out. It was. I also didn't close it. I couldn't watch them starve in glass.

choices.text: You let them loose on us.
You did what you could live with.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Yes. I did. I'll carry that. I'll help you carry what it costs. That's all I can offer.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: ...Thank you. I don't deserve that. I'll take it anyway.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Silence is fair.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Suddenly on her feet. Barking. Backing away from the dark end of the A-wing corridor.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Something unfolds from the last hold. It was sleeping in the cold dark. Now it's awake, and you're warm.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It shrieks without sound and lunges. You fire into it. It breaks for the stairs, toward the black water.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Waist-deep in freezing water. It turns on you in the stairwell. You end it there. Your hands won't stop shaking.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It slides into the black water and is gone. Somewhere, maybe, it comes up again.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The cart's floods blaze down the corridor. It recoils, folds itself back into the dark, and waits. You leave.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: There's a hot spring three miles north. If any are still sleeping nearby, they'll be there. In the warm.
